assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: I'm here with Susie and today we're looking at unusual places where people actually live.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 今天我和苏茜一起，聊聊世界各地人们实际居住的奇特地点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: did you see any interesting or strange homes around the world?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 有没有见过世界各地有趣或奇怪的住所？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: Well, it depends what you mean by strange.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 这要看你所说的“奇怪”是什么意思。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: I live in a detached house,
so the apartment buildings in New York, for example,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 所以，例如纽约的公寓楼，
对我来说就显得很奇怪。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: I really mean places that very few people know about.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 我的意思是真正鲜为人知的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: when I was on holiday last year in Peru,
I saw a really old city made out of mud.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.zh: 看到了一座由泥土建成、年代久远的城市。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_79fe9fa54e8bedf.text: You could say that is interesting.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: And so are the cave houses in the lowest part of China.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 中国最偏低的地区也有洞穴住宅。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: Take a look at the picture.
Some people think the cave houses look strange.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 有些人觉得洞穴住宅看起来很奇怪。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: But millions of people live in these houses.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 但有数百万人住在这样的房子里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: Many houses are below the ground.
Other houses are caves in the side of hills.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 另一些房子是山坡上的洞穴。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: They made them out of the soil and rock.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 它们由泥土和岩石建成。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.text: People started to live in them four ,000 years ago.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b617af0ab3a1d2b.zh: 人们四千年前就开始住在里面了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: It's about one ,000 kilometres west of the capital, Beijing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.zh: 它在首都北京以西大约一千公里处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: Actually, when I was younger, I went to Cappadocia in Turkey.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.zh: 其实，我年轻时去过土耳其的卡帕多奇亚。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: There are cave houses there too.
It's in Anatolia in the centre of Turkey.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.zh: 它位于土耳其中部的安纳托利亚。
这些建筑看起来像蘑菇。
很有意思的地方，不是吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: The caves formed from rock more than eight ,000 years ago.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.zh: 这些洞穴由岩石形成于八千多年前。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: People changed them into homes during the Roman period.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.zh: 罗马时期，人们把它们改造成了住房。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_87de6fac76ee3fd.text: Some people still live there now.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.zh: 对，那些是帕拉菲托斯高脚屋，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.text: Are they on a bridge too?
No, they build these houses over lakes or over the edge of the sea, not over rivers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.zh: 不是，它们建在湖面上或海边，而不是河上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.text: People started to build these over 100 years ago.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.zh: 人们一百多年前开始建造这种房子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.text: The people fish in the lake or the sea near their houses.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.zh: 人们在自家附近的湖里或海里捕鱼。
所以这些房子并不古老。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.text: hundreds of people still live like this.
they make my house look really boring.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f947adb8852f9fe.zh: 它们让我的房子看起来实在太普通了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: But did you know that some people live on bridges?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 不过，你知道有些人住在桥上吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: I think I recognise this bridge.
It's beautiful and it looks very old.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 它很漂亮，而且看起来很古老。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: but it's actually in Florence, north of Rome.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 但其实它在罗马以北的佛罗伦萨。
人们在1345年建造了这座桥。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: There was another bridge there before, but an accident destroyed it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 之前那里还有一座桥，但一场事故毁掉了它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: So they made this one and people started to live there.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 于是人们建了这座桥，并开始住在上面。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.text: But the houses in the other picture look newer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c1055f3a02688b.zh: 但另一张照片里的房子看起来更新。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: OK, everyone.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 好的，各位。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: Today we are talking about interesting places.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 今天我们来谈谈一些有趣的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: I'd like to talk about the city of Vancouver in British Columbia,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 我想谈谈不列颠哥伦比亚省的温哥华市，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: Canada.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 加拿大。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: It's one of the most beautiful cities in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 它是世界上最美丽的城市之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: We often think cities are urban areas,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 我们常认为城市是都市区域，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: with traffic and modern buildings.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 有交通和现代建筑。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: We don't usually think cities have woods, lakes and fields,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 我们通常不会认为城市里会有树林、湖泊和田野，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: but Vancouver is a green city,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 但温哥华是一座绿色城市，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: a place that's good to live in because it has clean air,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 这里空气、

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: water and land.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 水和土地都很洁净，因此适合居住。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: Vancouver has the best parts of green forests and city life.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 温哥华兼具绿色森林和城市生活的优点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: I would like to talk about some of the history of Vancouver,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 我想介绍温哥华的一些历史，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: as well as some of the advantages and disadvantages of this green city.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 以及这座绿色城市的一些优点和缺点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: Vancouver,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 温哥华

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: originally,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 最初，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: was a place where the native people of the area lived and traded for thousands of years before Europeans came to live there in the 1800s.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 在19世纪欧洲人到来定居之前，是当地原住民生活和贸易了数千年的地方。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: Then,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 后来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: at the first city meeting,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 在第一次市政会议上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: the people of Vancouver asked the national government to give the city one thousand acres to use as a park.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 温哥华市民请求中央政府划拨一千英亩土地作为公园。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: They got the land from the government and started Stanley Park.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 他们从政府获得了这片土地，并建起了斯坦利公园。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: This was the start of Vancouver becoming a green city with many parks and beautiful views.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 这标志着温哥华开始成为一座拥有众多公园和美丽景观的绿色城市。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.text: But being a green city with lots of parks has both advantages and disadvantages.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_bff53e64438eaa0.zh: 拥有许多公园、成为绿色城市，既有优点也有缺点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: First of all, let's look at some of the positives.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 首先，我们来看看一些优点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: Stanley Park is a large park.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 斯坦利公园是一个大公园。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: In fact, because it is located in the city of Vancouver,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 事实上，由于它位于温哥华市内，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: it is the third largest urban park in North America.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 它是北美第三大城市公园。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: trees and even animals such as bald eagles,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 树木，甚至还有白头海雕等动物，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: As we know, lots of trees help clean the city air.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 正如我们所知，许多树木有助于净化城市空气。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: lots of parks give people many places to walk so they're healthier.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 许多公园给人们提供了很多步行的地方，因此人们更健康。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: Since Vancouver is near the mountains and the ocean,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 温哥华靠近山脉和海洋，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: people can enjoy the outdoors easily during the warm, sunny summers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 所以在温暖、阳光充足的夏天，人们很容易享受户外活动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: When people go to Stanley Park,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 当人们去斯坦利公园时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: they can enjoy ancient trees as they walk near the ocean.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 可以一边在海边散步，一边欣赏古树。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: Or they can have fun by Beaver Lake,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 或者可以在海狸湖边玩乐，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.text: helps make Vancouver one of the healthiest and cleanest cities in the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f3dac4077602be6.zh: 帮助温哥华成为世界上最健康、最洁净的城市之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: I'd also like to talk about some disadvantages of parks in Vancouver.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 我还想谈谈温哥华公园的一些缺点。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Space in a city is very important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 城市里的空间非常重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Having many parks means that people have less space to build houses and apartments.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 公园多意味着可用来建造住宅和公寓的空间更少。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Because Vancouver is located between the mountains and the ocean,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 温哥华位于山脉和海洋之间，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: there's not much room for new buildings.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 因此没有多少空间建新楼。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: This makes Vancouver an expensive city.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 这使温哥华成为一座生活成本很高的城市。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Also,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: when you have a beautiful place to live,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 当你有一个美丽的居住地时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: a lot of people want to go there.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 很多人都想去那里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: This makes the city crowded.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 这使得城市很拥挤。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Actually,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Vancouver has very bad traffic.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 温哥华交通拥堵很严重。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Lastly,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 最后，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: when you have a lot of parks,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 当你拥有许多公园时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: wild animals in the parks can sometimes be a problem.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 公园里的野生动物有时会成为问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: For example,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Stanley Park gives information to people about what to do if they see a coyote.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 斯坦利公园会告诉人们，遇到郊狼时应该怎么做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: In my opinion,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 在我看来，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: having coyotes in a city park is bad.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 城市公园里有郊狼并不好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: Finally,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 最后，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: while I think these disadvantages might mean that some people would not want to visit Vancouver,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 尽管我认为这些缺点可能让一些人不想去温哥华，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: I personally feel that most people would enjoy Vancouver.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 但我个人认为大多数人会喜欢温哥华。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: In my opinion, being close to nature and having a healthy city are worth paying a little more money for.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 我认为，亲近自然、拥有健康城市，值得多花一点钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: And a lot of people agree with this idea,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 而且许多人都同意这个看法，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: because Vancouver is a very popular place to visit and live in.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 因为温哥华是一个很受欢迎的旅游和居住地。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: So I would recommend that people visit Vancouver and enjoy the many parks,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 所以我会推荐大家去温哥华，享受众多公园，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: the clean,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 洁净、

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.text: healthy city and the interesting sights.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e685be507f8e53.zh: 健康的城市环境和有趣的景点。
